scope: Concise factual NPC entries for the remaining level-75 Eden index titles. Horizon custom Imperial Relief Effort relocations are excluded.

articles.title: Zonpa-Zippa
articles.intro: A former Manustery minister and the creator of Windurst’s Cardians.
articles.body_html: The present-day character appears in cutscenes during Doll of the Dead (Windurst 9-1), involving The Boyahda Tree. Follow that mission’s walkthrough; there is no ordinary town NPC to visit under this name. The Campaign-era character is a separate entry, Zonpa-Zippa (S).

articles.title: Zoreen
articles.intro: Regional merchant for Valdeaunia.
articles.body_html:
Location

Port Windurst — M-7, Air Travel Agency arrivals.

Trades while Windurst controls Valdeaunia. Sells Frost Turnip and Sage. Availability follows Conquest control; check the current regional map if the shop is unavailable.

articles.title: Zoby Quhyo
articles.intro: Regional merchant for the Elshimo Lowlands.
articles.body_html:
Location

Port Bastok — J-7.

Trades while Bastok controls Elshimo Lowlands. Stock includes Kazham Peppers, Kazham Pineapple, Mithran Tomato, Black Pepper, Ogre Pumpkin, Kukuru Bean, Phalaenopsis.

articles.title: Zubaba
articles.intro: Head lady-in-waiting in Heavens Tower.
articles.body_html:
Location

Heavens Tower — second floor.

Visit her during Written in the Stars (Windurst 3-2). Open the mission for the required items, route and completion steps.

articles.title: Zona Shodhun
articles.intro: Gardening helper and the Jeuno Mog House exit quest NPC.
articles.body_html:
Location

Port Jeuno — E-8.

Unlock Jeuno Mog House exits

  1. Bring one Yellow Rock.
  2. Trade it to Zona Shodhun to complete Pretty Little Things.
  3. Your Jeuno Rent-a-Room can then exit to the different Jeuno districts.

She also explains Gardening.

articles.title: Zhikkom
articles.intro: Weapon merchant at Dragon’s Claws Weaponry.
articles.body_html:
Location

Bastok Markets — F-10.

Shop stock

ConditionWeapons
Any Conquest standingBronze Knife, Cat Baghnakhs, Bronze Sword, Degen, Sapara
Bastok first or secondKnife, Iron Sword, Scimitar
Bastok first; Bastok citizensKukri, Mythril Sword, Broadsword, Tuck, Falchion

Prices vary with fame.

articles.title: Zon-Fobun
articles.intro: Quest giver for The Curse Collector.
articles.body_html:
Location

Bastok Markets — G-5.

Speak with Zon-Fobun to begin The Curse Collector. Open the quest for its requirements, item collection and reward.

articles.title: Zopago
articles.intro: Vana’diel Chocobo Society trainer for Bastok.
articles.body_html:
Location

Bastok Mines — I-9.

Start raising a chocobo

  1. Obtain a Chocobo Egg.
  2. Trade the egg to Zopago to begin Chocobo Raising.
  3. Return to him to manage your chocobo’s care.

articles.title: Zenobia
articles.intro: A resident NPC in the Metalworks.
articles.body_html:
Location

Metalworks — I-7.

Find her at the consular area.

articles.title: Zovriace
articles.intro: A San d’Oria patrol scout who travels through West Ronfaure.
articles.body_html:
Location

West Ronfaure — moving between the La Theine Plateau exit at F-12 and Southern San d’Oria’s gate at I-6.

He patrols the road rather than standing at a fixed spot. Look along that route if you need to find him.

articles.title: Zokima-Rokima
articles.intro: Windurst mission gate guard.
articles.body_html:
Location

Windurst Walls — H-7, by Heavens Tower.

Speak with him for available Windurst Missions. Accepting your first Windurst mission from him grants the title Heavens Tower Gatehouse Recruit.

articles.title: Zubu-Abibu
articles.intro: A Tarutaru resident of Heavens Tower.
articles.body_html:
Location

Heavens Tower.

A tower dialogue NPC.

articles.title: Zuber
articles.intro: The Marble Bridge Eatery’s attendant.
articles.body_html:
Location

Upper Jeuno — F-7, Marble Bridge Eatery.

He provides the Marble Bridge Coaster key item, which reports whether you meet the eatery’s entry restriction when entering Upper Jeuno. He also appears in Save the Clock Tower and Dawn (Promathia 8-4).

articles.title: Zexu
articles.intro: An NPC involved in The Sand Charm.
articles.body_html:
Location

Mhaura — I-9.

Speak with him when directed by The Sand Charm. Follow the linked quest for the required item and hand-in sequence.

articles.title: Zhon Kihshimo
articles.intro: A greeter at the Sailors’ Stay shops.
articles.body_html:
Location

Mhaura — I-8, Sailors’ Stay.

For armor and shields, speak with Graine. For weapons, go upstairs to Runito-Monito.

articles.title: Zoldba
articles.intro: Auction House representative in Norg.
articles.body_html:
Location

Norg — G-6.

Speak with Zoldba to open the Auction House menu.

articles.title: Zoriboh
articles.intro: Quest giver in Rabao.
articles.body_html:
Location

Rabao — F-6.

Related quests

  • Chasing Dreams
  • The Search for Goldmane

Open the relevant quest before speaking with him for its prerequisites and next destination.

articles.title: Zungutt
articles.intro: Melody Minstrel for Rabao cutscene replays.
articles.body_html:
Location

Rabao — E-8.

Speak with him to replay previously viewed Rabao scenes for a small fee. The replay list includes scenes from The Mithra and the Crystal, Trial by Wind, Chasing Dreams, The Search for Goldmane, I'll Take the Big Box, True Will and Carbuncle Debacle. Replaying a scene does not advance its quest.

articles.title: Zhamwaa
articles.intro: Residence attendant in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
articles.body_html:
Location

Aht Urhgan Whitegate — F-10.

Find him by the Mog House entrance.

articles.title: Zubyahn
articles.intro: A Whitegate NPC involved in Five Seconds of Fame.
articles.body_html:
Location

Aht Urhgan Whitegate — K-12, Shararat Teahouse.

During Five Seconds of Fame, speak with him between 05:00 and 07:00 Vana’diel time for the teahouse recording scene, after the required conversation with Ratihb. Follow the quest for the precise recording timing.

articles.title: Zwinam
articles.intro: An NPC beside Whitegate’s Wajaom Woodlands exit.
articles.body_html:
Location

Aht Urhgan Whitegate — H-10.

Use the nearby exit to reach Wajaom Woodlands.

articles.title: Zyfhil
articles.intro: A resident NPC in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
articles.body_html:
Location

Aht Urhgan Whitegate — F-9.

articles.title: Zwaluh
articles.intro: Leathercraft image-support craftsman.
articles.body_html:
Location

Al Zahbi — G-11.

Speak with him for Leathercraft synthesis image support. The native service handles ordinary and advanced image support.

articles.title: Zwiyaam
articles.intro: A resident NPC in Al Zahbi.
articles.body_html:
Location

Al Zahbi — I-7.

articles.title: Zorchorevi, R.K.
articles.intro: San d’Oria’s Conquest overseer at the Elshimo Lowlands outpost.
articles.body_html:
Location

Yuhtunga Jungle — G-11.

Appears while San d’Oria controls Elshimo Lowlands. San d’Orian adventurers can obtain Signet, deliver Elshimo Lowlands Supplies for a Supply Run Mission, and use the guard’s applicable Conquest services. He also accepts Sheep Leather Missive to start the local Garrison.
